key_insight: F3-AGI v4.0 combines gated learning, complexity-guided program synthesis, and active exploration for CPU-native, few-shot abstract reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Its resource-aware learning and symbolic search may inform efficient engineering AI, but the abstract reports no solid-mechanics or constitutive-modeling validation.
method: Gate plasticity using mistakes, Fisher-EMA preconditioning, and virtual ATP budgets.
Guide program synthesis by complexity, residual patches, and smallest-pair early rejection.
Drive Expected Free Energy exploration with 512D random projections and dead-signature pruning.
evidence_signal: Reported results include 57/400 ARC-AGI-1 tasks solved at pass@2 with 1.62 s/task mean latency, 91.67% final accuracy on a synthetic continual-learning stream, and 15/15 levels completed in a local interactive suite.
watch_item: Calibration-slice success (38.00%) exceeds strictly uninspected hold-out success (10.86%), underscoring limited generalization despite low latency.
paper_title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
